ns2:section.sectionText: Financial Modeling concentrates on developing the skills and techniques required to build financial models using Excel. Students will use excel features and built-in functions to build models in the Time Value of Money, Financial Statements Forecasting, Value at Risk, Ratio Analysis, Bond Pricing and Duration, and Options Pricing. Course will meet in 24 DKH (OIM Computer Lab). Registration restricted to Finance seniors. Prerequisite is credit in FIN 300.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Finance major(s). Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
